name: Hive 1.10.5
notes: Reliable workspace navigation. Returning to a workspace now restores the exact chat and channel you had open there — it no longer resets to the empty 'select a chat' placeholder or jumps to a different channel. This fixes the intermittent behavior from 1.10.3/1.10.4. Includes the earlier workspace improvements: remembered project folder, and Code/Diff reachable without opening a chat.
